<function name="SetPaintBackground" parent="DMenuBar" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Sets whether or not the background should be painted. Is the same as <page>DMenuBar:SetDrawBackground</page></description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="shouldPaint" type="boolean">Should the background be painted</arg>
	</args>
</function>
